lines.text: Hi Niamh, you're thirty weeks along, is that right? What are you coming in with?
I'm coming in with pain at the front of my pelvis when I turn over in bed.
Any pain going to the toilet or any leaking?
Going to the toilet is fine, no problems there at all.
Keep your knees together when you roll over in bed, like they're glued, and get in the car bottom first.
I'll fit you with a support belt today and we'll review in two weeks.
That would be great, thank you.
Grand so. Mind yourself now, Niamh.
Mr Doherty? How're you keeping? In you come.
Ah, not too bad, only for this back of mine, I'm after putting it out lifting the lawnmower into the van.
